title: Three complementary analyses of simulated breast cancer cases
simulation_disclosure: All samples, genotypes, positions, LD, gene identifiers, RNA counts and subtype labels are synthetic.

analysis_1.question: What molecular variation is represented by unsupervised factors?
main_summaries: Training-only factor-budget selection and masked reconstruction
post_hoc_diagnostics: Capture of the known residual programme subspace
Genotype-only prediction of unobserved RNA in independent participants
analysis_1.diagnostic_scope: Eight prespecified first-replicate fixtures, one per scenario and sample size; not all 80 models.

analysis_2.question: Can a supervised genotype and RNA signature distinguish TNBC from other simulated breast cancer cases?
main_summaries: Independent-test balanced accuracy against combined, RNA, genotype and clinical ridge references
Feature-selection frequency across ten independent simulation replicates per cell
analysis_2.qualification: Selection frequency is simulation reproducibility, not a bootstrap estimate on the same patients. Prediction does not establish causal regulation.

analysis_3.question: Are regional genotypes associated with expression, and do associations differ by subtype?
main_summaries: Preserved ordinary F and HC3 sensitivity with 800 fresh null cohorts
analysis_3.qualification: Observed error excesses preclude certification for confirmatory eQTL inference without further calibration.

interpretation: No MOFA+ versus DIABLO winner is defined. Inherited MOFA predictive records remain available for provenance but are not primary discovery endpoints or a ranking of integration methods.
provenance: The simulations and fitted models were completed before this reframing. New summaries are explicitly post hoc and do not change seeds, effect sizes, fit choices or test participants.
